boundary_conditions: This hypothesis tests a model implementation, not the historical cause of collapse.
contrast_definition: Complete source-pinned NIST baseline versus published milestone claims.
contrast_groups: No complete reproducible baseline or materially divergent rerun
falsification_conditions: A complete independently rerun baseline fails a prespecified milestone, or an identified necessary input cannot be sourced and its sensitivity prevents the claim from being tested.
null_model: The published description is insufficient for independent reproduction, or material undocumented/version-specific choices change the modeled sequence.
observable_prediction: A source-pinned rerun using the complete declared NIST baseline produces the reported initiation and global-progression milestones within preregistered measurement tolerances under the same stated condition.
primary_estimand: Binary reproducibility status of each prespecified NIST milestone under a source-complete baseline; no inference to historical cause.
scope: WTC 7 NIST-specific modeled sequence; public release plus any subsequently lawfully available primary inputs.
statement: NIST’s reported fire-to-global-collapse sequence is reproducible from a complete, source-pinned implementation of its declared geometry, thermal fields, connection assumptions, damage-transfer rule, and solver settings.
support_conditions: Exact source bytes, executable solver version, and model-result extraction procedure are preserved.
